redeem: Launch Anime Fighting Simulator on Roblox and wait until you load into the world.
Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
Select the Codes button at the top of the Shop window.
Type or paste the code into the Enter Code Here box and press Redeem.
notes:
Anime Fighting Simulator is a training and combat game published by the Anime Fighting Simulator | BZ group, and this version went live on Roblox in June 2026. You build up your stats through training, unlock powers drawn from popular anime series, and take on bosses and other players, while summoning champions that train and fight next to you. Mounts, auras, weapons and titles round out the collection side.

Codes here are usually large bundles of Chikara and Tensei Shards, stat, yen and training boosts, trait rerolls, and event tokens such as Clover Tokens. Those resources shorten the long stat grind and pay for rerolls. The developers post new codes in their Discord and on the game page, usually tied to updates, member milestones, or compensation after downtime.

faq.q: Where do the Anime Fighting Simulator developers post new codes?
faq.a: New codes are posted in the developers' Discord and on the game's Roblox page. They usually come out with updates, member milestones, or as compensation after downtime.

faq.q: What do Anime Fighting Simulator codes usually give?
faq.a: Codes usually give large bundles of Chikara and Tensei Shards, along with stat, yen and training boosts, trait rerolls, and event tokens such as Clover Tokens. These rewards shorten the long stat grind and help pay for rerolls.

faq.q: Is there a code in the Anime Fighting Simulator game description?
faq.a: Yes. The game's Roblox description tells players to use CLOVERPASS. It gives 1k Clover Tokens, 1k Tensei Shards and 2.5k Chikara Shards.

tips: Train your stats every time you play, even for a few minutes. Stats decide how hard you hit and how much damage you can take, and most other progress builds on them.
Summon champions early on. They train and fight alongside you, so each one you level up keeps adding to your progress.
Take on bosses once your stats can handle them. Bosses drop rare items and rewards that training alone will not give you.
Hold off on fighting other players until your stats are higher. Early on, time spent training does more for you than losing fights.
useRewards: CLOVERPASS gives 1k Clover Tokens, 1k Tensei Shards and 2.5k Chikara Shards. Clover Tokens belong to an event, so spend them on the event rewards before it ends instead of letting them sit. The Chikara and Tensei Shards are worth holding until you know which power or reroll you want most, since spending them in one place usually gives a bigger jump than splitting them up.
